svg.title: Crystal Essence — Prism and Lattice. Draft 1 / Crystal classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Prismatic Focus forks into Razor Lattice then Splintered Mountain Heart, or Flaw in the Stone then Break Along the Flaw. Jade Lattice forks into Flawless Sphere then Adamant Core, or Light Turned Back then Entombed in Crystal. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Crystal-classified Crystal Essence jutsu.

Three of its five jutsu carry a Crystal damage row (Prism 50, K\u014dsai Shipp\u016b 40, Crystal Cave 40, all 60 AP / cooldown 7), so raw Crystal power is the primary emphasis and the deepest offensive commitment. Its two Increase Damage Taken rows (Sphere single target, Cave area enemies, both 35% for two rounds) anchor an exposure route, while the 40 AP Crystal Sphere's 35% Decrease Damage Taken and the Cave's 40% Reflect each anchor a defensive route that honours the Defensive trait. Crystal"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split and calibration: Foundations +2/+2 (Prismatic Focus: IDG and exposure, 3 rows; Jade Lattice: DDT and Reflect, 2 rows). Hidden Arts take one tag each: +2 Damage on three rows, +2 IDT on two rows, +3 DDT and +3 Reflect on single rows. Capstones: +3 Damage (route +5, Taiyo parity on three rows), +3 IDT with +3 IDG (two-row IDT held to +7), +5 DDT or +5 Reflect with +3 IDG. IDG sits only on the Foundation and capstone secondaries, so it tops out at +5 (Shipp\u016b 35 -> 40).","Main tree and passives: Shipp\u016b's IDG row lists Crystal/Earth/Fire/None with a Ninjutsu filter, so it amplifies the kit's Crystal hits and any Ninjutsu, Crystal, Earth, Fire or element-less damage (basic attacks, most normal jutsu, weapons) for two rounds; the bloodline IDG passive (25 + 0.15/lvl) multiplies on top. Sphere's IDT (None/Ninjutsu) and the Cave's IDT (Crystal/Earth/Fire/None, no stat filter) amplify allies' matching hits too. Pierce hits ignore IDG/IDT/DDT; Reflect includes them.","Delivery and uptime: every jutsu has cooldown 7. K\u014dsai Shipp\u016b and Crystal Cave are 60 AP circle spawns on an OTHER_USER target at range 4 (damage rows friendly fire ENEMIES, no ally hazard); Prism is a 60 AP single-target shot; Crystal Sphere a 40 AP single-target cast. Buffs and exposure last two rounds, so staggered Shipp\u016b, Sphere and Cave casts give enhanced windows on four to six of every seven rounds. Shipp\u016b's self IDG and Sphere's self DDT arrive only when the cast has a legal target.","Fourth-purchase choices: Burst (01, 02, 03) finishes with Flaw in the Stone (exposure 39%) or Jade Lattice (DDT 37%, Reflect 42%); Exposure (01, 04, 05) with Razor Lattice (+2 Damage) or Jade Lattice; Bastion (06, 07, 08) with Prismatic Focus (IDG 40%, exposure 37%) or Light Turned Back (Reflect 45%); Reprisal (06, 09, 10) with Prismatic Focus (IDG 40%) or Flawless Sphere (DDT 40%). Capstone-less hybrids (e.g. 01, 02, 04, 06) spread +2/+5 across several tags; 14 legal full builds.","Defensive routes: Sphere's DDT row and the Cave's Reflect row list all four stat types with no element, so each matches nearly every hit the caster takes (DDT excludes pierce; Reflect includes it and bypasses shield absorption). DDT 35 -> 45 and Reflect 40 -> 50 stay under their caps (100; 60% of the hit for Reflect). The bloodline's 15% Earth DDT passive multiplies rather than adds. Reflect pays only when the caster is struck in the two rounds after a 60 AP area cast: a duelist's build.","Untouched rows: Prism's 25% wound and Summoning: Jade's summon (A rank, 70 AP, cooldown 10, PVP only) are unsupported tags and receive nothing; the Jade summon is the kit's only mode-restricted jutsu and carries no supported row. Bloodline passives are not potency targets. Skill-tree effects are suppressed in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin, so no node applies there."],"risks":["Classification: Crystal is not exclusive in the census (Sea-Maiden's Kiss, a deferred record, carries Crystal on 5 rows, 3 of them damage), and whether any NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN jutsu carries Crystal is unverified (no non-bloodline catalog with effect rows exists in the repository). The tree assumes a bloodline-scoped whole-kit classification; a bare element match would leak to that kit.","Resolver: 3 of the 8 supported rows (Crystal Sphere DDT and IDT, Crystal Cave Reflect) have no element and fall back to None under the current resolver, so they are unreachable without the proposed classification change; reaching them with affectedElements including None would also reach every element-less row on any jutsu the player casts.","Exposure breadth: +7 makes both Increase Damage Taken rows 42% for two rounds, one single-target (Sphere) and one on area enemies (Cave), and they amplify allies' matching hits as well as the caster's (pierce excluded). The route was held to +7 rather than +10 because the tag reaches two rows; team value exceeds solo value and was not simulated. Trim Break Along the Flaw's +3 IDT first.","Reflect cap and uptime: 50% leaves ten points of headroom under the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage cap, but main-tree or item Reflect sources could saturate it and waste part of the +10. Reflect requires being hit during the two rounds after a 60 AP Cave cast and both combatants alive; realized value depends on enemy behaviour and was not simulated.","IDG stacking: Shipp\u016b's 35% row already stacks additively with any main-tree or item IDG and the bloodline IDG passive (about 28.75% at level 25) multiplies the result; the +5 ceiling adds five additive points to one row. Each row stays far below the 100 cap, but the combined per-hit amplification in a Shipp\u016b window was not simulated against peer kits.","Decrease Damage Taken scope: DDT is a damage modifier and does not touch pierce hits; the Sphere's 35 -> 45 window also only exists when the 40 AP cast has a legal OTHER_USER target in range 4, so the defensive routes depend on an enemy being reachable, not on the caster's choice alone. The exposure half of the same cast is unchanged by the DDT nodes.","Damage calibration: the Burst build reaches +5 on three rows (Prism 55, Shipp\u016b 45, Cave 45), Taiyo Kami parity; the strongest row-weighted full build is below Taiyo Kami's 31 because this kit has one fewer supported row and no Afterburn. If the tree proves weak, Jade Lattice is the lever (a +1 Damage secondary would raise the ceiling to the +6 guardrail, as Shinrai Ou's Raiment of Storms does).","Delivery and friendly fire: Shipp\u016b and Cave are circle spawns whose realized hits and exposure depend on positioning; the dossier flags no ally-hazard rows (friendly fire ENEMIES on both area damage rows and the Cave's area exposure). Prism's damage row has friendly fire ALL on a single-target cast, so if an ally is targeted the Damage nodes raise that hit too."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":7,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"reflect":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":8,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":3,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":2,"reflect":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","reflect"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Crystal classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Crystal Essence jutsu inherit Crystal potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"reflect":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":7}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"reflect":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"reflect":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"reflect":5}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":7,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"reflect":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"reflect":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"reflect":5}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"reflect":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"reflect":5}},{"ids":["01","06","09","10"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"reflect":10}},{"ids":["06","07","08","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":3,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"reflect":5}},{"ids":["06","07","09","10"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":3,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"reflect":10}}]}

g.text: Draft 1 / Crystal classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Crystal Essence jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Splintered Mountain Heart path + Flaw in the Stone
Break Along the Flaw path + Razor Lattice
Entombed in Crystal path + Prismatic Focus
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · REF: Reflect
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
